On every 8th frame framestore does a blocking MsgSend to journal while still inside its own request handling. Journal, before replying, does a blocking MsgSend back to framestore, which is not receiving because it is waiting on journal. That is a send cycle (framestore -> journal -> framestore), so cam's next send to framestore blocks forever, which matches cam stopping after 7 TICKs. Fix: framestore notifies journal with a pulse instead of a blocking send, and journal queries framestore after the notification, so no cycle can form.

cause: pilot (prio 30) MsgSends to planner (base prio 7), which cannot get the CPU: its channel is _NTO_CHF_FIXED_PRIORITY, so it does not inherit pilot's priority, and mapper's two busy threads at prio 18 starve it. A second hazard: every 30th plan, planner makes a blocking MsgSend to auditd, and auditd synchronously sends back to the single-threaded planner. That is a send cycle, and once auditd is no longer receive-blocked it sits at prio 10 behind mapper. Fix: let planner inherit its client's priority, and send planner->auditd as a pulse at the sender's (inherited) priority, so planner never blocks on auditd. auditd still sends to planner.
